text:
Type: velvet square cushion with piped edge
Use: comfort and a soft accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, glam, classic
Materials: soft cotton velvet with a gentle sheen, self piping
Colors: medium cool grey
Shape: square, plump, smooth plain surface, thin piped seams along the edges, medium size
Feel: soft, refined, calm, cozy
Goes with: white, navy or blush textiles, brass, dark wood, grey sofas; contemporary, glam or classic rooms

product.description: Cotton velvet gives depth to the colour and softness to the touch.
